propositions: Pause and resume operations on the bridge gate must be rollback-safe and preserve old reader compatibility with dual-format state containing gated_mode plus paused/reason/who/paused_at metadata

New pause operations must return rc 0 with an exact anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker before lock acquisition or ticket mutation, while the scheduled workflow recognizes only that marker to skip commit-and-push

Pause provenance must capture repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp, enforce idempotency on same-reason re-pause with metadata preservation, and refuse pause without overwrite on blank reason, missing identity, missing remote, or CAS conflict
Resume must safely clear observed OID state via CAS without decoding, recovering corrupt blobs without traceback, while legacy gate rc 4 and pre-gate reconcile-check early returns remain functional
Corrupt gate state must return rc 1 with clean recovery message without traceback, and old reconcile vocabulary plus legacy workflow environment behavior must remain unchanged and covered by tests

Durable pause/resume contract must be publicly exposed via CLI help, generated reference, user guide, exit-code docs, and release notes without shipping --until, automatic expiry, new-only blob, gate rename, or old-vocabulary removal
